What video does in Wyoming that stills cannot

Wyoming is one of West Michigan's largest cities and the established southwest suburb of Grand Rapids. The housing stock is affordable and settled, which makes it a high-velocity entry-level and move-up market: first-time buyers and growing families trading up without leaving the area.

For this market the case for video is speed. Wyoming moves fast and the buyer pool is broad, so a vertical cut that shows the whole home in thirty seconds does more work here than a slow cinematic piece. A still gallery is a set of disconnected rooms; a walkthrough is the only format that carries how a home actually connects, and a vertical cut is the only one that survives a thumb moving at speed.

What a Wyoming listing reel looks like

The standard deliverable is a vertical 9:16 cut for Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok: hooked in the first second, paced fast, captioned so it reads with the sound off, and ending on the address and your name rather than ours. It is shot during the same visit as the photos, so the listing gets stills and video from one appointment.

  • The hook — the single best frame in the house, first, before anyone decides to scroll
  • The walk — entry through the main living spaces in one continuous read, so the floor plan makes sense
  • The proof — the two or three features this listing is actually priced on
  • The setting — a Wyoming exterior and, where it earns its place, a drone establishing shot
  • The close — address, price point, and the agent's name and contact

Where the reel actually goes

The cut is delivered in a format you can post directly: vertical for Reels, Stories, and TikTok, with a horizontal export on request for a listing page or a YouTube upload. Most agents get more mileage out of the vertical, because it is the version that runs in the feed where buyers are already scrolling. The reel is yours, unbranded to ECS, so it works as your marketing rather than ours.

Wyoming real estate video FAQ

What does real estate video cost in Wyoming?
A single-listing vertical reel is $150. A multi-listing or branded package is $300. Video runs on top of any photo tier — Essential $245, Showcase $375, or Signature $525.

Do you shoot the video on the same visit as the photos?
Yes. Stills and video are captured in the same appointment, which is why a listing can get both without a second scheduling round or a second trip charge.

Is the reel branded to you?
No. The cut ends on your name and contact, not ours. It is your listing marketing.

How fast do I get a Wyoming listing video back?
Video is delivered on the same next-business-day standard as the photos in the great majority of cases; a longer multi-listing package is scheduled with a delivery date up front.
